Seven years later, he couldn’t find joy in anything in the world. So, he didn’t care about the re-opening of the gifted academy’s admissions after seven years. Until he saw a wrinkled application form rolling on the floor. Instead of trying to enroll the child in the gifted academy, he offered various excuses. The document, thrown away like trash without even being considered due to being from a workhouse.

“I approve this child’s admission.”

He wasn’t particularly interested. It was just a warning to those who tried to act arbitrarily. So he couldn’t even remember the name of the child he picked.

“My name is Ivy Alden.”

The child he met in front of his wife’s and daughter’s graves resembled the daughter he had always imagined.

Eun-Jo decides to commit group suicide, unable to cope with the burden when her daughter dies in an accident. However, she opens her eyes to the day before. She soon realizes that once midnight strikes, she is sent forty-eight hours backwards. How can she stop this? Eventually, she decides to continue reliving the past so that she can improve the life of her future self. But what happens when nothing she does has an impact on her future?

To make sure her webtoon is perfect, author Baek Mireu starts working as a maid at the Sophist Hotel to help inspire her story, but ends up in trouble that could make her lose her job. Thankfully, the good-looking and wealthy hotel president Kang Hyuk is there to save her, but there's a catch—she must agree to a contractual relationship to help get his marriage-crazed mother off his back. But even though the relationship is fake, Hyuk slowly finds that his feelings for Mireu might be real.

Katelyn Grint has spent her whole life pining for a man who's in love with her best friend. But a chance encounter with Terius Hert, the no-nonsense and infuriatingly attractive commander of her brother's order of knights, turns her world upside down. What was supposed to be a one-time mistake quickly becomes something much more complicated... and permanent. Katelyn is about to discover that not everyone is who they appear to be—and that some firsts lead to the most unexpected beginnings.
____
"Please place your seal here, Lady Grint."

"No!"

"Don’t make this harder than it needs to be. Just do it." 

"I said no! Why on earth would I marry you?"

"Then who would you marry, my lady?"

At a distance close enough to feel each other’s breath, Therious Hurt gently raised his index finger and began tracing soft circles over my flat belly. My body stiffened at the strange, indescribable sensation.

"My child is right here. Who do you think you’re marrying if not me?"

Eun is a loner and reads tarot cards–which always foretell unhappy auguries–to amuse herself. They each think the other is strange. These two seem to be opposites, but they have more in common than they think. Who knows what the future holds in store for them.

But due to a turn of events, Kang Yeon-woo's identity as Strawberry Fairy is revealed! How will his favorite artist react now that she knows the face behind the famous cute user Strawberry Fairy?

A Green Bug? A Crocodile? A Paprika?

For the past three years Kijin Lee has lived as a secretary to Director Jinheon Joo of Xitec Trading with little to no personality or will of her own - even a haircut required his permission. With sales at Xitec Group plummeting, she’s been transferred to assist the CEO, who happens to be the cousin of Director Joo. Her job depends on her ability to help him and Xitec Group, but this unruly CEO may prove to be her greatest challenge yet.

Add a few politically feuding older brothers into the mix—a dashing captain, an emperor, and an archduke—and chaos is inevitable. Can Efna make it through nap time, or will she lose her sanity first?

description.fr:
Gu Yeon-seo, l'as de l'équipe marketing de la société AZ. Derrière son apparence impeccable et ses capacités exceptionnelles se cache un secret : il est un gumiho (renard à neuf queues) qui, après 200 ans, a enfin développé ses neuf queues.

Tout le monde pensait qu'il était destiné à devenir un renard céleste, mais Yeon-seo a obstinément choisi de vivre comme un humain, réussissant ses examens d'équivalence du lycée, ses admissions à l'université et même la recherche d'emploi, souvent brutale.

Mais une erreur imprudente menace de tout révéler. Son identité secrète est découverte par le développeur Yoo Min-hyeok... et, à la grande surprise de Yeon-seo, sa magie de renard ne fonctionne pas du tout sur lui.

Pour protéger sa vie quotidienne paisible, Yeon-seo élabore un plan ridicule : conquérir Min-hyeok et sa jeune soeur. C'est ainsi que commence la romance chaotique et intime du gumiho dans son quartier !

description.ru: Хаесео Хан - обычный трудолюбивый офисный работник, которого больше всего беспокоит, что его упускают из виду из-за повышения по службе, самодовольных коллег и стресса на рабочем месте. То есть до тех пор, пока она не окажется вовлеченной в пророчество, которое определит судьбу фантастического мира! В царстве Империи Бистон Хаесео рассматривается как оракул, который определит следующего преемника престола и принесет мир в страну. Надеясь завоевать расположение Хаесео и стать следующим императором, три очаровательных, но эксцентричных принца Бистона переходят в мир Хаесео, чтобы начать свою совместную жизнь как соседи по дому!

Although he manage to get the upper part of the armor... He has no pants... So what? As long as the top looks cool. Victims deceived by Parsley's armor are on the rise!

To defeat the Demon King and become a hero, Parsley and his companions' adventure begins now!

We’ll give your standard urban legend with a comedic twist! A touch of science will turn a seemingly scary ghost story into a comedy! There is a ghost that plays piano by dropping her blood onto the keys!? Wait… Just how dense does the blood droplet have to be in order to actually press a piano key? Waaait… How much blood loss would the ghost suffer if she were to play piano all night? Won’t she be dried up like jerky by morning?

description.en: "If you can't kiss your first love, you're dead!" Joo Dooyoon has no will to live because of his infirmity since childhood. One day, a devil suddenly appeared. It said that if you fail to meet the terms of the contract, you will die. And the condition is to kiss your first love…!

Yoonsung confessed to the one he liked, and thanks to his charms they got into a relationship. After the excitement ran out, they broke up and moved away from each other in a hurry. However, it turns out that they both moved in the same building, and they'll be neighbors

Early 1960s, South Korea. A time when the nation stood on the edge of hunger and hope, when even one bowl of pig slop stew made from army leftovers could mean survival. In this era of post-war poverty, a man named Jeon Jung-yoon was desperate to give his people a proper, dignified meal. Meanwhile, Kim Hang-pil, a fresh-faced recruit just discharged from KATUSA, joins Jeon’s dream—driven by the thought of someone he loves. That someone is Lee Young-hee, his unspoken love, now selling bowls of pig slop from a shantytown on the fringes of society. Amid hunger, heartbreak, and hardship, they work tirelessly to create something revolutionary: A warm, simple meal for the masses. A symbol of survival. A taste of comfort. The birth of ramen.

Our story begins with Jigyo, the crown prince, having recently been exiled from the palace with a guard, Dangeum, and the man who raised him, Chunggeum. The three are forced to pass their remaining days in a quiet village made up of mostly elderly residents. This leads to a listless and lonely Jigyo, who begins pressing Dangeum to relieve his traditional post as a voiceless shadow, and the two quickly grow closer. Hints of a bloody conspiracy, Dangeum’s mysterious origin, and a Chunggeum who seems to know more than he's letting on - just how are these three characters connected, and what will happen to them during exile?
description.es: Nuestra historia comienza con Jigyo, un príncipe heredero, que ha sido exiliado del palacio con un guardia, Dangeum, y el hombre que lo crío, Chunggeum. Los tres son forzados a pasar sus días en una tranquila aldea en la que casi todos sus residentes son gente mayor. Esto nos deja un apático y solitario Jigyo, que comienza a presionar a Dangeum para abandonar su condición de sombra silenciosa, y pronto se vuelven cercanos. Insinuaciones de una sangrienta conspiración, el misterioso origen de Dangeum y un Chunggeum que al parecer sabe más de lo que dice saber… ¿Cómo es que éstos tres personajes están conectados?, ¿Qué pasará con ellos durante su exilio?

Manche Isekai-Storys sind unglaubliche Reisen voller Entdeckungen und persönlicher Entwicklung – aber nicht die der neu erwachten Trixie Giuseppe. Kaum fünf Minuten in ihrer Geschichte, ist sie auch schon mit dem schlimmsten Kerl aller Zeiten verheiratet und wird von ihren Eltern verstoßen. Trixie will um jeden Preis aus diesem Leben ausbrechen und nimmt verzweifelt eine Stelle als Dienstmädchen in einem abgeschiedenen Landgut an. Dort angekommen muss sie feststellen, dass der „junge Meister”, dem sie dort dienen soll, niemand Geringeres ist als der berüchtigte Leone Atarta. Scheinbar hat sich die Autorin der Geschichte ordentlich vertan, denn der gute Leone benimmt sich nicht nur ungehobelt, sondern voll und ganz wie ein wildes Tier. Some people start off their possession stories on an epic journey of discovery and growth–but not the newly awakened Trixie Giuseppe. She’s not even five minutes into her novel but is already married to the biggest creep ever and disowned by her parents. Wishing to free herself from the shackles placed by her awful husband, Trixie takes a job as a servant at a remote estate. But she discovers too late that the “young master” she has to serve is the empire’s foolish prince, Leone Atarta. The novel’s author must’ve misspelled the word “feral” as Leone turns out to be much more of a beast than a simple beauty. 길들인 강아지가 자꾸만 나를 잡는다. 

"아무것도 해주지 않아도 돼."

И так начинается рассказ Трикси о том, как она пытается приручить своего “пса” и сделать из него выдающегося наследного принца.

But suddenly, she’s back on the subway on her way to work. But this secret of hers turns out to be not so secret after all. Oneul, who has the same ability, meets her and tells her that she and Oneul are both players in a dating simulation game. Will they be able to see the game to its end by getting married to their main storyline characters and escape from the time loop?

description.vi: Haru có một bí mật. Cô ấy có khả năng quay trở lại một thời điểm nhất định mỗi khi kết hôn. Một giây trước, Haru vẫn đang đứng trước bàn thờ. Nhưng1 giây sau, cô ấy lại ở trên tàu điện ngầm, đang trên đường đi làm. Bí mật này của cô ấy hóa ra lại không hề bí ẩn chút nào. Oneul, người cũng có khả năng tương tự, gặp cô ấy và nói rằng cả hai đều là người chơi trong một trò chơi mô phỏng hẹn hò. description.en: Kim Yoonsung was a regular guy living a happy life with his family. That is until he discovers he is a “Trace,” a class of mutant humans with special abilities who emerged to fight the mysterious monsters known as “Troubles,” who threaten Earth. Shunned by ordinary humans, many Traces live in hiding. That’s what Yoonsung intended to do, but when his family is suddenly taken from him, he is forced to team up with a wild crew of Traces to find them. Little does he know what “troubles” lie ahead.

description.en: A young girl becomes the princess in a foreign kingdom and vies for the cold prince's love despite the obstacles that stand between them.

"Under the pink-tinted summer moon, a high school girl's 'magical girl double life' begins!"

Wolgo High School is famous for its mystical forest that will help you find your soulmate. With the 'Summer Moon Festival', the school's biggest summer festival where you can find the love of a lifetime, just one month away, the school grounds are filled with pink excitement. Freshman Han Yeo-Reum, whose goal is to find someone to confess to by the festival day, tries to confess to the most popular male upperclassman in school... but at that moment, out of nowhere, she turns into a ☆magical girl☆?!

biography.en:
HYBE is a Korean Entertainment company used to be know as Big Hit Entertainment before changing their name.

They are in collaboration with LINE WEBTOON for webtoon series base on their kpop groups under them such as BTS, TXT, ENHYPHEN, Le Sserafim, and &Team.

description.pt-br: Roberto Hoffman, um oficial da Marinha SEAL, tinha uma família amorosa e uma vida tranquila. No entanto, sua vida sofre uma reviravolta repentina quando zumbis aparecem. Após perder a esposa e o filho, Hoffman fica apenas com a sobrinha, Ara. Os dois embarcam no maior navio de cruzeiro do mundo, o Noah, na esperança de encontrar uma nova terra para a vida. Será que este navio lhes prometerá a esperança que procuram?

description.en: Minjun sets up a fake profile to get Eunju, his crush, to accept his follow request on social media. Now, with her daily activities and whereabouts available at his fingertips, he uses this information to move in as her next-door neighbor. But little did Minjun know, that Eunju’s life isn’t anything like what she posts online–this sends him down an unexpected path, where he learns that following Eunju turns out to have its consequences.

The female lead, Yunseo, is shocked by the sudden confession, but she doesn’t want to embarrass her company. However, from the company’s point of view, his contract terms were too good to decline so they decided to sign the contract, but…!

Completely out of her element and out of money, Jae-Gyu manages to get into trouble as soon as she gets off the bus. She expected the move would be rough, but she never thought she’d meet the last person she ever wanted to see again — Hee-Do, a boy from grade school whom she bullied mercilessly. However, one of the criminals who was brought in seems slightly different than the others. He escapes the Colosseum and starts a counter-attack on it. Said criminal is Jihoon Ryu, a university student who loves cover and concealment, and someone who has been deemed a criminal for reasons unknown. Follow the action filled revenge story of Jihoon, who turns out to have been a member of the Special Forces in the past!

Is murdering to save lives justifiable?
Dr. Seowoo Han is targeted for revenge and ends up killing her attacker in self-defense. Her detective husband helps her dump the body and frame it as the work of a serial killer. The only problem? The real serial killer knows what they did, and is blackmailing them into committing more murders...

Dra. Seowoo Han é alvo de vingança e acaba matando seu agressor em legítima defesa. Seu marido detetive a ajuda a se livrar do corpo e enquadrá-lo como obra de um serial killer. O problema? “I found you…!”

A scroll suddenly appeared right in front me.
And a person came out of it…..

I...isn’t that an Imoogi…?!?

He asked me to turn him into a dragon…!

Auna is a girl forced into servitude to a petulant princess who presents her with a furry fox cub. Soon afterwards, Auna embarks upon the adventure of a lifetime when she learns that fox is really an adventurous boy trapped by a magical spell! Before she knows it, the pistol-packing teen and her unlikely ally journey into a fantasy realm unlike anything you've ever seen!

Seung Hun is a boy who has never been in love. Yi Woo is a girl who wants to be loved for herself and not her beauty.  
  
Jongyi is the mysterious person who will become their object of passion. Right from the start, a strange love triangle forms between these 3.  
  
But as always love is long painful path especially if the object of it is completely oblivious to your attentions.

Hyobi is a famous teen star on TV who has lived her whole life as her mama’s doll. Suddenly, Hyobi’s mother decides to send her back to high school on a whim. Hyobi feels lost in all this and she doesn’t have a single friend at school. Then she meets a girl named Soyule, an outcast of the class, and Soyule's childhood friend Chanbi. Now, Hyobi feels drawn to Soyule and Chanbi, for they don’t know who Hyobi is outside of school…

It all happened so fast.
Everyone's changing! For some reason, people are turning red and tearing each other apart like zombies. Meanwhile, Lee Park is a high school student with an empathy disorder who suddenly begins to experience emotions for the first time. Will he be able to survive amidst all the chaos?
-From Manta (Note, despite Manta's description referring to the main character as "Lee Park" the manhwa itself uses the name "Ibak Kim")

Cliff Dillon appears to be just another delinquent looking for a place in Seoul's seedy underworld. But is that really all? Or is there more to this tough, good-looking high-school student than meets the eye?

The news of the destruction of the Earth, which had been floating around as nothing but nonsense, came out on the convenience store TV.
At that moment, with a bang! I lost consciousness and woke up a few days later,
but the city had already turned into nothing more than ruins.
‘Where am I...? And who am I?’
An old man who had died and a tattoo shaped like an ‘eye’ in the male protagonist’s lost memories.
In search of his memories, he heads to the shelter with the female protagonist,
but will the two protagonists be able to survive the 465 days before the Earth is supposed to be destroyed?
description.ko:
낭설로만 떠돌던 지구 멸망에 대한 뉴스가 편의점 TV에서 흘러나왔다.
그 순간, 펑! 소리와 함께 정신을 잃게 된 후 며칠이 지나서야 깨어나는데,
이미 도시는 폐허와 다름없게 변해버렸다.
‘여긴 어디지...? 그리고 나는 누구?’
남자 주인공의 잃어버린 기억 속 숨을 거둔 늙은 남성과 ‘눈’모양의 문신.
그렇게 기억을 찾아 여자 주인공과 함께 대피소로 향하게 되는데,
과연 두 주인공은 지구 멸망 예정인 465일 뒤에 무사히 살아남을 수 있을까?

description.en: Long ago, the world was in chaos until the Ultimiter appeared. Now, everyone lives happily… Except for Savior Gu. Can Savior overcome his past, and emerge as the new Ultimiter?!

title.en: The Last Will of a Crush

description.en:
Mingyeol is a happy-go-lucky twenty-six-year-old girl who recently quit her job. With extra time on her hands, she spends her days crushing on Tae-eun, a cute boy who works at her favorite coffee shop owned by Tae-eun’s older sister Huiyeon. Mingyeol stops by every day despite Tae-eun’s lukewarm reactions. What seems like a lucky break finally arrives when he asks for a favor. He hands her a letter, asking her to give it to Huiyeon a week later. When Mingyeol confronts Tae-eun, he acts like he doesn’t remember anything at all. Mingyeol is now armed with a mission to save her crush, but will he open up to her and tell her what’s wrong?
